_meta.description: Crosstab of region x segment with an AGG_WEIGHTED_MEAN cell (revenue weighted by session_minutes) decorated with OVERLAY_PAIRWISE_WEIGHTED_TWO_MEANS_Z at ROW scope: each tests one region's weighted mean revenue against another within each segment column, reading the weighted moments {weighted_mean, m2_weighted, sum_weights, sum_weights_sq} from Response.Components.Crosstab.CellComponents. n_basis is required with no default: kish uses the Kish effective base (n = n_eff = sum_weights^2 / sum_weights_sq), the right reading for these sampling-style weights (weight_field is a probability weight); weights treats the weights as frequencies (var = m2/(sum_weights - 1), n = sum_weights) and is accepted only on a frequency-weighted cell, so on this host it is refused PROCESSING_CONFIG. z = (m_i - m_j) / sqrt(var_i/n_i + var_j/n_j) with a normal-CDF tail; each cell holds the pair's two-sided p-value. Unlike the AGG_WELFORD sibling the weighted-mean cell is mergeable, so the crosstab scan stays fused. The family emits RAW p-values only; direction and thresholds are the embedder's presentation concern.
_meta.name: crosstab-pairwise-weighted-means
